Q9024.reason: The statute bars resisting the arrest itself, but if the jury believes the suspect the nightstick beating was excessive force and his punch was justified self-defense even though the arrest was lawful.

Q9025.reason: Zoning compliance is not a complete defense, and totally blocking an existing solar use when the house could be sited elsewhere is an unreasonable private nuisance, so the categorical judgment for the neighbor should be reversed.

Q9027.reason: Civil law is the body of law that establishes rights between persons and provides remedies for their violation.
